standard_prerequisites.use: G_{k-bar} is a scheme, the anchor for the descent chain.

standard_prerequisites.use: The four-step field-extension chain and the Galois descent that closes the proof.

standard_prerequisites.name: Limits of affine opens
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Limits, lemmas descend-opens and limit-affine (cross-chapter, named)
standard_prerequisites.use: Recover W as the base change of an affine open U' over a finite subextension.

core_obligations: Chain the reductions: purely transcendental K of huge degree, then the perfect closure, then the algebraic closure, keeping G_{K-bar} a scheme throughout.
Represent a closed point's image g by Spec(L) -> G_{K-perf} and realize the fibre T as Spec of a filtered colimit algebra; find an affine open W in G_{K-bar} containing the image.
Descend: choose quasi-compact V in G_{K-perf}, find a finite Galois K'/K-perf with affine U' whose K-bar base change recovers W.
Apply the Galois base-change and quotient-scheme lemmas to the H-invariant closed subscheme inside U'.
proof_roadmap: Extension-chain reduction, limit-theoretic affine choice, and Galois descent on an invariant closed subscheme.
difficulty_reason: Four interlocking reduction layers (transcendental, perfect, algebraic closure, finite Galois descent) with a limit argument for the affine open.
